scope: 本次连接诊断：从宿主无设备到重试后COM4/JTAG枚举成功；未执行PS初始化/DDR。

entries.name: 完整PnP及驱动诊断
entries.command:
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
$presentUsb = @(Get-PnpDevice -PresentOnly | Where-Object { $_.InstanceId -match '^(USB|FTDIBUS)\\' -or $_.Class -eq 'Ports' -or ($_.Status -ne 'OK' -and $_.Class -ne 'Bluetooth') } | Select-Object Class, FriendlyName, InstanceId, Status, Problem)
$usbCim = @(Get-CimInstance Win32_PnPEntity | Where-Object { $_.PNPDeviceID -match '^(USB|FTDIBUS)\\' -or $_.PNPClass -eq 'Ports' -or ($_.ConfigManagerErrorCode -ne 0 -and $_.Present) } | Select-Object Name, PNPClass, PNPDeviceID, Status, ConfigManagerErrorCode, HardwareID, Service, Manufacturer)
$serialRegistry = $null
if (Test-Path -LiteralPath 'Registry::HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE\HARDWARE\DEVICEMAP\SERIALCOMM') { $serialRegistry = Get-ItemProperty -LiteralPath 'Registry::HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE\HARDWARE\DEVICEMAP\SERIALCOMM' | Select-Object * -ExcludeProperty PSPath, PSParentPath, PSChildName, PSDrive, PSProvider }
[pscustomobject]@{ checked_at_utc8=[DateTimeOffset]::UtcNow.ToOffset([TimeSpan]::FromHours(8)).ToString('o'); present_usb_ports_or_problems=$presentUsb; usb_driver_details=$usbCim; serial_registry=$serialRegistry } | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 8

用户再试一次后的USB/COM检查
entries.command:
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
[pscustomobject]@{ checked_at_utc8=[DateTimeOffset]::UtcNow.ToOffset([TimeSpan]::FromHours(8)).ToString('o'); com_ports=@([System.IO.Ports.SerialPort]::GetPortNames()); serial_ports=@(Get-CimInstance Win32_SerialPort | Select-Object DeviceID, Name, PNPDeviceID, Status); usb_bridges=@(Get-PnpDevice -PresentOnly | Where-Object { $_.InstanceId -match '^(USB|FTDIBUS)\\' -and ($_.InstanceId -match 'VID_(0403|03FD|1443|10C4|1A86)' -or $_.Status -ne 'OK') } | Select-Object Class, FriendlyName, InstanceId, Status, Problem); hw_server=@(Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -Filter "Name='hw_server.exe'" | Select-Object ProcessId,ParentProcessId,ExecutablePath); listener=@(Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 3121 -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object OwningProcess) } | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 7

entries.command:
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
$runItem=Get-Item -LiteralPath 'C:\Users\22061\.codex\worktrees\96a3\FPGA_Competition\report\evidence\S2B-T06\ps_connection_debug_20261009_113002_r01'
$probeItem=Get-Item -LiteralPath 'C:\Users\22061\.codex\worktrees\96a3\FPGA_Competition\report\evidence\S2B-T06\ps_connection_debug_20261009_113002_r01\jtag_targets_probe.py'
$vitisItem=Get-Item -LiteralPath 'D:\Xilinx\2026.1\Vitis\bin\vitis.bat'
if ((Get-FileHash -LiteralPath $probeItem.FullName -Algorithm SHA256).Hash.ToLowerInvariant() -ne '201dc67de8427662fdf1852309c270eda24f2a9bf70cc2670802b152208c3dc6') { throw '被审探针SHA改变' }
$probeOut=Join-Path $runItem.FullName 'jtag_probe_stdout.log'
$probeErr=Join-Path $runItem.FullName 'jtag_probe_stderr.log'
foreach ($fileName in @($probeOut,$probeErr)) { if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $fileName) { throw '探针日志已存在，拒绝覆盖' } }
$probeClock=[Diagnostics.Stopwatch]::StartNew()
& $vitisItem.FullName -s $probeItem.FullName 1> $probeOut 2> $probeErr
$probeNativeExit=$LASTEXITCODE
[pscustomobject]@{ launcher_exit_code=$probeNativeExit; elapsed_seconds=$probeClock.Elapsed.TotalSeconds; stdout=$probeOut; stderr=$probeErr; result=(Join-Path $runItem.FullName 'jtag_targets_result.json') } | ConvertTo-Json
